name: @somewhere-tech/cli
stderr:
Usage: somewhere [options] [command]

CLI for somewhere.tech

Options:
  -V, --version                                        output the version number
  -h, --help                                           display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                                      Authenticate with somewhere.tech (no account yet? run `somewhere signup`)
  signup                                               Create a somewhere.tech account — opens the sign-up page and prints its URL
  logout                                               Revoke and remove stored credentials
  whoami [options]                                     Show current user info
  auth                                                 Manage stored credentials
  init [options]                                       Write a local starter; when signed in, also create a project and link this directory
  link                                                 Link this directory to an existing project (alias for `init --link`)
  project                                              Manage projects
  projects [options]                                   List all projects
  deploy [options] [dir]                               Deploy the current directory (anonymous automatically when logged out)
  pull [options] [project]                             Download a project's deployed source files to the current directory. Scaffolds a tsconfig.json + package.json (only if absent) so `somewhere typecheck` can catch undefined symbols locally before you deploy.
  typecheck [options] [dir]                            Check a source project with `tsc --noEmit`. Reports TypeScript errors with file:line before deploy. Requires a local tsconfig.json; add one for a new app, or run `somewhere pull` for an existing deployed app.
  promote [options] <preview_session_id> <preview_id>  Promote one exact preview to production. Pass the preview_session_id and preview_id returned by the preview; promotion is refused if production or the preview changed.
  rollback [options] [project]                         Revert production to the previous deployed version. Use this when a promote shipped a bad build — it restores the version that was live before, including its functions. (Requires a previous production version to return to.)
  db                                                   Run SQL against your project's database
  postgres                                             Attach your own Neon Postgres database to a project (sw.postgres)
  docs [options] [topic]                               Read platform docs. No login needed — every topic is public. Quick topics: start, docs, guides, security, migration, llms. Example manual topic: `somewhere docs sw.db`.
  advisor [options] <question>                         Ask the somewhere.tech platform advisor; login adds linked-project context
  catalog [options] [tool]                             Browse the live somewhere.tech platform tool catalog; pass a tool for its input schema or a category such as email
  logs [options] [project]                             Show recent logs
  errors [options] [project]                           Show what recently went wrong in a project — the curated 24h view (endpoint, status, error, time). The fastest way to see what is breaking in production without digging through raw logs. Rows are split into EXCEPTIONS (nobody chose it — an uncaught throw or a 5xx) and REFUSALS (your handler answered 4xx on purpose, e.g. a 401 from your own auth gate). Use --exceptions to see only what broke.
  env                                                  Manage environment variables
  run [options] <script>                               Run a one-off script once against your project's live dev bindings (sw.db / sw.fs / sw.ai / sw.search …) without deploying, and print its return value + console logs. The script is an ES module: export default async function (sw) { ...; return value }. Example: somewhere run seed.js
  status [options] [project]                           Show project and workspace status
  open
